what: BN6's Security Cubes stand sunk under their floor (src/emu/bn6_map.h BN6_SCUBE_*, docs/rom/net-maps.md, Link Navi obstacles; issue #735): Central Area 1's spawn record (0x08072BA0, id 0x09) puts it at (212, 138, -12) and Seaside Area 2's (0x08076830, id 0x52) at (-248, 168, -8), each on the middle of the one panel its walls box, at floor height 0; its sprite's foot is drawn that far over its origin, where the obstacles' (z 0, or their floor's height) meet theirs. BN5's own cubes (one map's spawn list at 0x0807FFF8, ids 0x0A-0x0C, records whose sprite is 7:0x01) stand at z 0. A layer's cube, given the flames' spot at z 0, floated over the panel's far edge; on its panel's middle at z -12 it stands as Central Area 1's does, the two drawn side by side (BN6's untouched, warped into in the engine).
